headline: Patroller-Grade Technical Fabrics For Peak Performance
body: Tested by professionals in the harshest backcountry terrain. Built with technical fabrics that deliver uncompromising performance when you push your limits.
rationale: This copy targets the Fitness Enthusiast by directly using their required messaging preferences of technical fabrics and performance claims, while leaning into the professional patroller pedigree to satisfy their demand for items that truly perform.
